requirements.evidence: `routes/web.php:59-60` adds `entity.queues` and `entity.serve`; `app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:57-61` mount authorizes `create`; `Queues.php:91-98,124-138,140-161,163-197` cover open/rename/toggle/access; `app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:49-55,67-104,111-154` cover defaults, callNext and the ordered/filtered list; `app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:55,62,70-75` and `resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:6-18` add the tabs; `resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php:49-56` adds the links; all required `ui.*` keys exist in `lang/en/ui.php:23-24,110-154` and `lang/pt_BR/ui.php:23-24,110-154`. Foreign/missing ids, duplicate slug, inactive queue, no selection, tampered mode and rate limiting are handled (e.g. `Queues.php:93,109,126,142,156,165,193-194`, `Serve.php:69-104,130-136`).

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through the existing actions (`Queues.php:5-7,80-84,128-133,158,196`; `Serve.php:88`), authorization uses policies (`Queues.php:95,111,144,167,201`; `Serve.php:51,118,134`), server context is `#[Locked]` (`Queues.php:25`; `Serve.php:32,44`), markup uses `x-label`/`x-input` and Bulma, and CHANGELOG/business-rules are updated. Deviation: the manager role check is embedded in the Blade view (`queues.blade.php:117`), and the queue-name inputs lack the project's `#[Validate]` pattern (`Queues.php:31,48,77-89,124-138`).

security.evidence: Ids from the client are resolved through entity-scoped relations (`Queues.php:93,109,126,142,156,165,193-194`; `Serve.php:75,130-136`), writes go through actions that authorize (`CreateQueue`, `UpdateQueue`, `SetQueueAccess`, `CallNextTicket`), `lastCalledTicketId` is `#[Locked]` (`Serve.php:44-45`), output is escaped with `{{ }}` throughout, and the rate limiter is keyed per user/entity (`Serve.php:79-100`). The remaining gap is that `$name` and `$renameName` are public client-writable properties without `#[Validate]`/`rules()` and `create()`/`rename()` do not call `$this->validate()` (`Queues.php:31,48,77-89,124-138`); the actions still validate server-side, so the impact is limited.

tests.evidence: `tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesTest.php:46-62` checks the route/component 403, `:142-153` unauthorized create, `:250-262` tampered `editingQueueId`, `:355-374` foreign membership/queue, and `:403-437` every action after demotion; `tests/Feature/Entity/ServeTest.php:42-56` covers access, `:138-156` foreign/missing/uncallable queues, `:216-243` foreign queue/no grant, `:256-274` mode tamper and locked state, `:276-305` rate limiting; `MembersTest.php:433-490` covers the tabs; `LocalizationTest.php:189-195` and `NavbarRenderTest.php:142-163` cover locale parity and navigation.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses the existing domain actions and Blade components, adds no service/repository layer, keeps helpers `protected` and small (`Queues.php:191-227`; `Serve.php:111-154`), and uses constants instead of magic numbers (`Serve.php:28-30`). The duplicated five-key payload in `Queues.php:233-262` is a small cleanup opportunity, not over-engineering.

readability.evidence: Methods are small and named for their intent, with comments on untrusted state (`Queues.php:35-55`; `Serve.php:35-47`). Minor issues: a fully-qualified role enum check in Blade (`queues.blade.php:117`), untyped action parameters (`Queues.php:91,107,154,163,178,183,191`), the duplicated render payload (`Queues.php:233-262`), and the implicit `tryFrom` fallback in `Serve.php:141-148`.

scope.evidence: The diff is limited to the new queues/serve components and views, the members tabs, the navbar, the two lang files, routes, CHANGELOG/business-rules and tests; no unrelated refactors, TV/broadcasting, ticket issuance UI or domain-rule changes.

issues.explanation: `$name` and `$renameName` are client-writable public properties with no `#[Validate]`/`rules()` and `create()`/`rename()` do not call `$this->validate()`, contrary to the project's mandatory Livewire rule; the domain actions validate them server-side, so impact is limited, but the component boundary is inconsistent.

Manager detection (`in_array($membership->role, [\App\Models\UserRole::Owner, \App\Models\UserRole::Admin], true)`) puts business logic and a domain enum FQCN in the Blade view; compute it in the component or policy and pass a flag.

`CallMode::tryFrom($this->mode)` makes an invalid or tampered `mode` silently render all tickets (no `when` filter) while `callNext()` rejects it; validate or default the mode explicitly in `waitingTickets()` for consistent behavior.

The tabs' `aria-controls` references `panel-invites`/`panel-members`, but only the active panel is rendered, so the inactive tab points at a missing element; render both panels and hide the inactive one (or drop `aria-controls`) to keep the ARIA relationship valid.
The access-denied early return duplicates the five-key view-data array; extracting a small helper or computed property would prevent the two payloads from drifting apart.

review.summary: Adds the queues management page, the attendant serve panel, members tabs, navbar links and both-locale strings, with thorough Pest coverage. Authorization, entity-scoped id resolution, escaping and rate limiting are strong; the main gaps are missing `#[Validate]` on the queue name fields, role logic in Blade, and a few minor view/robustness nits. Approve with minor changes.
